html:
"Croatian kingdom" is the map's label, for 900, for the Croatian state on the eastern Adriatic, then a duchy about to become a kingdom.

The Croats settled in Dalmatia and the lands inland in the 600s. In the 800s their dukes accepted Frankish overlordship and then broke free; the pope recognised Duke Branimir in 879. Around 925 Tomislav became the first king. He held off the Hungarians and the Bulgarians, while the coastal cities stayed under the Byzantines.

The kingdom peaked under Peter Krešimir IV in the 1000s. After its native line died out, Croatia accepted the king of Hungary in 1102 and stayed tied to the Hungarian crown for eight centuries. Today's Croatia looks back to this kingdom.
sum: "Croatian kingdom" is the map's label, for 900, for the Croatian state on the eastern Adriatic, then a duchy about to become a kingdom.
